g.text: [more than 10 sign-in attempts from this address in a minute]
[credentials invalid, or the account is banned]
Silent refresh, on any later request
The credential routes are rate-limited per address: 10 a minute on
sign-in and 5 on registration, against 60 everywhere else (NFR-05).
The cookie is refreshed as well as the client store: the route
proxy reads the cookie, so a refresh that updated only the store
would end the session after 15 minutes and lose unsaved work.
